scope: Thesis Make dependency graph and self-contained TeX source archive only. No regenerated PDF, typography, bibliography freshness or scientific-claim acceptance.
changes: All chapter TeX files, figure PDF/PNG files and the Makefile are dependencies of main.pdf.
arxiv.tar.gz includes main.tex, main.bbl, all eight chapters and figures.

details: A fresh PDF fixture stays up to date before input changes.
Touching a chapter, figure or Makefile schedules the actual compiler command.
The actual make arxiv output contains every recursively referenced literal TeX input and graphic, byte-identical to the sources.
